title: Independent qualification stage before an evolve verdict is recorded
mechanism: After a cycle's own evaluate/measure step, a second agent with no access to the candidate's transcript re-runs the measurement on a fresh replica copy from the same frozen family and the same pinned config, compares against the bet's bands, and only then the verdict memory is written with two timestamps: completion (candidate's own result) and qualification (independent re-measurement); a candidate whose qualification is missing or disagrees is 'unqualified', never 'accepted'

expected_gain.rationale: rekursiv.ai's auto-autoresearch run kept preliminary and independently reviewed results separate and had the coordinator qualify without backdating; a review gap left 35 completed panels unqualified, i.e. unreviewed results were the failure mode. Expect fewer accepted bets at first (false accepts removed) and a trustworthy verdict history

evidence.claim: implementation and evidence artifacts kept preliminary results separate from independently reviewed results; the coordinator independently checks the original triplet and accepts the result without backdating that decision to when the evidence became ready
a later review gap left 35 completed panels unqualified after a service interruption: evidence needs someone responsible for checking and passing it on
experiments inherit from a named parent recipe and are scored as delta BPB against the parent at the same budget over pinned seeds
